faq.q: What is the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition?
faq.a: Grand Theft Auto VI's Ultimate Edition bundles the full game with the Ultimate Edition Upgrade for 99.99 USD, a 20 USD premium over the Standard Edition. It adds premium content on top of the same base story.

faq.q: What extra content does the Ultimate Edition Upgrade add?
faq.a: It unlocks an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, businesses and customization options through Jason and Lucia's story, plus two additional side missions woven into the main campaign.

faq.q: Can the Ultimate Edition Upgrade be bought separately from the base game?
faq.a: Yes. The Ultimate Edition Upgrade can be bought on its own at any time, including after release, so Standard Edition owners are not locked out of the extra content.

faq.q: Does the Ultimate Edition come with the same pre-order bonuses as Standard?
faq.a: Yes. Ultimate Edition buyers receive the same Vintage Vice City pre-order pack and free month of GTA+ that Standard Edition buyers get when they pre-order.

faq.q: Do the two extra side missions in the Ultimate Edition change the main story?
faq.a: Rockstar has not detailed this. The record only says the two side missions are woven into the main campaign, without describing what happens in them or whether they affect the story's outcome.
